Title: Content Calendar
Description: A content calendar for the Umbraco backoffice. See, per day, which content was created, is scheduled to publish or unpublish, and was deleted. Available as a Content section dashboard and as a Calendar view for Child items, with Month, Week, Day and List views and infinite editing in a side drawer.
